name: @shadhil/api-types
description: Shadhil CRM — Shared TypeScript types and Zod schemas for the 9 NestJS modules. Re-exports Prisma-generated model types from @shadhil/database and provides request/response DTOs as Zod schemas (inferred TypeScript types via z.infer). One source of truth for validation in NestJS pipes AND Next.js route handlers.
